generationHistory.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original premium slot-game catalogue title card, one wide 2:1 landscape image.
Primary request: professionally illustrated key art for Phantom Manor, retaining its moonlit Gothic estate, midnight raven, violet mist and spectral mint highlights.
Scene/backdrop: midnight blue/violet sky, softly glowing moon behind distant clouds, faint bare branches and mist. Keep the outer margins dark and quiet.
Subject: a compact original Gothic manor vignette with steep roofs, tall narrow warm amber windows, wrought-iron gate hints and a midnight raven perched near the front. A subtle translucent mint spirit-wisp curls around one antique skeleton key near the manor; no human figures. Architectural and prop designs must be original rather than a copy of existing art.
Style/medium: polished professionally illustrated fantasy 3D key art with delicate carved-stone detail, subtle antique gold, controlled depth and soft atmospheric light; premium, mysterious and restrained. Not flat clip art, a screenshot or a photorealistic horror still.
Composition/framing: wide 2:1. A LARGE two-line title balances the compact manor-and-raven vignette. Keep all title letters and every main subject, including roofs, raven and key, inside a compact central rectangle x=23%-77%, y=25%-75%; intentionally leave broad dark atmospheric background beyond this rectangle on all sides. Title and manor must remain recognizable and clear at 256x128 thumbnail.
Color palette: midnight #0d1028, deep violet #151329, violet #5b4a8d, spectral mint #73d0ba, antique gold #c8b47a, lavender glow #a58cff, ivory silver lettering.
Lighting/mood: cool moonlight, restrained violet/mint mist, warm window pinlights, elegant haunted mystery.
Text (verbatim): "Phantom Manor" exactly once, Phantom on first line and Manor on second, large clear bold Gothic-inspired serif typography with ivory faces and fine antique-gold edge. Keep letter forms readable, not distorted or overdecorated.
Constraints: no other words, slogans, payout claims, reels, buttons, fake UI, brand logos, watermarks, money, blood, gore, additional religious or cultural motifs. Single original finished game catalogue image.
